tools.name: get_sun_sign_reading
tools.description: Returns a short, free reading based only on a birth date: sun sign (simple date table) and Pythagorean life path number, with a few sentences about character, written in the third person by default. No predictions, no personal data stored.

tools.name: create_christmas_star_card
tools.description: Creates a festive Christmas card (text plus SVG image) about someone, from their birth date and optional first name: sun sign and life path number, described as character, not prediction. tools.name: get_birth_chart
tools.description: Computes a real birth chart from astronomical positions (tropical zodiac): Sun to Pluto with sign, degree and retrograde flag, major aspects with orbs, and a short character-focused interpretation. tools.name: get_transits
tools.description: Shows where the planets are now (or on a given UTC date) and which major transits they make to a person's birth chart, with orbs and exact dates, for one day or a 7-day week. Short reflective interpretation, no predictions, nothing stored.

tools.name: compare_charts
tools.description: Compares two birth charts (synastry): the closest aspects between person A's and person B's planets, with orbs and a short, balanced summary. Birth times and places are optional. tools.name: list_celebrities
tools.description: Lists the famous people you can compare charts with in compare_charts (about 1000 most-followed real people on X, birth dates from Wikidata cross-checked with Grokipedia). Optional search query (name, handle or description such as 'singer'); returns up to 25, most followed first. Most are date-only.
